dedupe_keys.name: gtfs and osm public transport accessibility analysis package

description: This Python package prepares public-transport accessibility maps from GTFS timetables and an OpenStreetMap walking network. The quickstart shows loading one or more operator feeds, choosing a service date and area boundary, building the walk network, and writing a GeoPackage, CSV and run metadata. A modeller could use the output accessibility level as an input to transit demand, equity or disruption scenarios. The project authors explicitly call the package pre-alpha. The India profile values are placeholders pending method decisions, so they are not calibrated evidence about Indian travel behaviour. The quickstart documents an optional saved OSM network for reproducible offline runs and a Windows process-shutdown caveat. This review checked only repository documentation, metadata and file paths; it did not install the package, query Overpass or inspect a generated grid. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 for code, while GTFS feeds and OSM source data have separate rights. Coverage depends on the supplied feed and area, not a published national dataset. Related resources are those input providers and any independently verified accessibility layer.
licence: GPL-3.0 for package code; GTFS and OSM inputs retain provider-specific terms.
